text.en:
The percentage of net earnings to be declared and remitted by the
MIAA and PIA as dividends to the National Government as provided for under Section 3
of Republic Act No. 7656 is adjusted from at least fifty percent (50%) to the rates
specified hereunder:
...
1.
2.
Manila International Airport Authority
Phividec Industrial Authority
The adjusted dividend rates provided for under Section 1 are only
applicable on 1997 net earnings of the concerned government owned and/or controlled
corporations.

By the President:
